AccountId.description: Unique identifier of the customer account.

LoyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty program.

IsPrimary.description: Defines the primary loyalty membership for the account.

State.description:
State of the loyalty membership. The default is `Enrolled`.

New

Pending

Enrolled

Canceled

Declined

Code.description: Loyalty membership code, such as an identification number printed on a loyalty card visible to the customer.

MembershipNumber.description: Customer-facing membership numbers, e.g., printed on a loyalty card.

Points.description: The loyalty points for the account in that membership.

ExpirationDate.description: Expiration date of the loyalty membership in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

Url.description: URL of the loyalty membership in external loyalty system.

LoyaltyTierId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty tier.
